test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is 'sloping'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• sloping - inclined from a horizontal or vertical line.
 
• slipping - failing to grip or make proper contact with a surface.
 
• sliding - able to move smoothly along a surface.
 
• sinking - go down below the surface of something, especially of a liquid; become submerged.
 
 
 
• The sentence with the blank needs an adjective in the blank to describe the **noun branches. **
 
• In such a case, sloping or option 1 is the correct word for the given blank. 

*Correct passage - **She was flying over the hills and felt delighted at the (1) sight of the tall trees and their (2) **sloping **branches below her. She could (3) **even **see a river flowing in a zig-zag fashion. Birds (4) **flew **alongside making chirruping sounds as if (5) **welcoming **her to the skies.*
